popup.body: 18 retail locations are profiled in this report across seven major retailers. Store types covered include big-box chains, warehouse clubs, specialty game stores, and local used-game shops. Best Buy North Austin — with the widest PS5 Slim selection in town — and Target Austin North — with the best current bundle pricing — are two highlighted locations from the report.

popup.title: Best Buy North Austin
popup.subtitle: 9607 Research Blvd · 78759
popup.body: The widest selection of PS5 Slim SKUs in Austin — from the $549.99 disc console and $499.99 Digital Edition to Fortnite, Cobalt Star, and Spider-Man 2 bundle packs. Full in-store trade-in and open-box programs available. Best Buy Totaltech members get additional discounts.

popup.title: Target Austin North
popup.subtitle: 8601 Research Blvd · 78758
popup.body: Target's Fortnite Flowering Chaos bundles offer the best value — $449.99 for the disc console and $399.99 for the Digital Edition, roughly $100 off MSRP. Order Pickup, Drive Up, and same-day Shipt delivery all supported. Circle 360 members stack an additional 5% back.
